name: Sunburst
summary: Radial hierarchy — inner ring = top level, outer rings = children — with a centre readout and drill-down.
summary_zh: 径向层级图：内环为一级分类、外环为下级，中心显示总数或当前层级，可点击下钻。
description_zh: 用同心圆环展示多层级构成，例如集团 > 业务板块 > 产品线收入。内环为一级（标注名称与占比），外环为下一级（径向标注名称），角度代表数值；颜色按一级分组（子级为同色系浅色，Others / Other 为灰色）或按指标（如增长率，发散色阶）。数据格式与矩形树图相同：id / parent 树表或平表 + encode.path。中心显示总数，悬停时显示当前扇区数值与占比；点击分组下钻、点击中心返回上一级，点击叶子节点交叉筛选。适合 2–3 层、强调“整体—部分”层级关系的场景；需要精确比较面积时优先使用矩形树图。
best_for: Executive summary visual where the hierarchy itself is the message
avoid_when: More than 3 levels or > ~40 leaves (labels become unreadable — use a treemap)
Precise size comparison is required (use a bar)

parent.desc: Parent node id; '' or missing for the root

name.desc: Node label (id / parent mode); also the cross-filter field

value.desc: Size of each leaf (parents are summed)

path.desc: Flat data: hierarchy fields from inner to outer ring, e.g. ['segment', 'player'] (overrides id / parent)

color.desc: Metric for diverging colour, e.g. growth

colorBy.desc: auto | group | metric — auto = metric when encode.color is set

colorMid.desc: Midpoint of the diverging metric scale: a number or 'avg' (value-weighted average)

sort.desc: desc | asc | null (data order); clockwise from 12 o'clock

innerRadius.desc: Centre hole as a share of the outer radius

labels.desc: auto (name + share of the view on every ring) | name | none — 11px, never truncated or shrunk: a label that does not fit its slice is left to the tooltip; a highlighted slice too thin for its label gets an outside callout

minLabelAngle.desc: Slices thinner than this (degrees) are not labelled

center.desc: Centre readout: total, drilled node or hovered node

rootName.desc: Centre caption at the top level (defaults to the single root node, else 'Total')

drill.desc: Click a group to drill in; click the centre to go back up

highlight.desc: Node name(s) drawn in the accent colour (e.g. the client)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

metricFormat.desc: Metric format; defaults to the color field format

interactions: Hover: ancestors stay in focus, centre shows the slice value and share
Click a group to drill in; click the centre to go back up
Click a leaf to cross-filter (non-selected leaves fade)
Animated transitions when filters change; drill level is kept
